ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (dark grey to black) dominance across ~95% of the visible surface with localized high-intensity (white) clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curvature for both lobes, transitioning into an upward-swept taper toward the distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the lateral edges of both tips and several circular scars on the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced texture and volume accumulation at tips due to barnacle growth, altering the expected smooth boundary.
